description: A new, blank Google Slides deck in a Drive folder or My Drive's root, to build with batch_update_presentation. Returns its id, link, revisionId and the object id of the title slide Slides gives every new deck.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

folder_id.description: Drive folder id to create it in. Takes precedence over folder_path.

folder_path.description: Folder path under My Drive, e.g. "Clients/Acme". Both empty means the root.

name: create_presentation
title: Create a blank deck
